parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must comply with directions issued by the government to block access to information generated, transmitted, received, stored, or hosted in any computer resource.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies procedures for complying with government directions to block access to information.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries hosting information subject to government blocking orders.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement to block access as per government direction.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must provide technical assistance and facilities to authorized agencies for monitoring and collecting traffic data or information.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document outlines procedures for providing technical assistance to authorized agencies for traffic data monitoring.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries hosting traffic data or information.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement to assist authorized agencies in monitoring traffic data.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must follow prescribed procedures and safeguards for blocking access to information or monitoring traffic data.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies procedures and safeguards for blocking access or monitoring traffic data as required by law.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries subject to government directions on blocking or monitoring.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation covers both blocking access and monitoring traffic data procedures.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must not attempt to secure access to protected systems without authorization.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits unauthorized access to protected systems and outlines consequences for such actions.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries managing protected systems.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the prohibition against unauthorized access to protected systems.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must comply with government authorization to access protected systems.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies procedures for complying with government authorization to access protected systems.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries managing protected systems.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement to comply with government authorization for accessing protected systems.
